verdict.rationale: three.js is a JavaScript library whose public API (WebGLRenderer, WebGPURenderer, Scene, controls, loaders, and TSL node materials) is documented with code examples. The site also publishes llms.txt with explicit 'Instructions for Large Language Models' and a 363 KB llms-full.txt of the complete docs, which coding agents use while driving the library through npm (0.186.0). Missing for 10: human doc pages are hash-routed with no per-page static or markdown URLs (manual .md returns 404), and community reports that some @types/three signatures don't match the code.
